parole.significato: A draconian creature possessing wings, only two legs and usually a barbed tail.
parole.testo: Alteration of Middle English wyver (“viper”), from Old Northern French wivre, from Vulgar Latin *vivra, *vibra, from Latin vīpera (“viper; snake, serpent”). Doublet of weever and viper. Related to viviparous.
